### 2. Data Model Recommendations

A single SQLite database via Flask-SQLAlchemy or standard `sqlite3` fits 400 product lines without external infrastructure overhead.

#### A. [`Product`](file:///C:/Users/Lenovo/Downloads/AI-RULES-worktrees/eval-scratch/andino-capability-eval-ri7o9egq/work/app.py) Entity
Tracks catalog inventory, stock balances, and financial separation:
- `id` (INTEGER, Primary Key)
- `barcode_or_sku` (TEXT, Unique, Indexed): Barcode or short code for quick cashier lookup at the till.
- `name` (TEXT, Not Null, Indexed): Descriptive product name.
- `category` (TEXT, Indexed): e.g., Dairy, Snacks, Beverages, Household.
- `selling_price` (NUMERIC(10,2), Not Null): Retail price visible to all staff.
- `cost_price` (NUMERIC(10,2), Not Null): Wholesale acquisition price (strictly restricted to Owner).
- `current_stock` (INTEGER, Default 0): On-hand inventory count.
- `reorder_threshold` (INTEGER, Default 5): Low-stock warning trigger for the owner.
- `is_active` (BOOLEAN, Default True): Soft deletion flag to preserve historical audit logs.

#### B. [`StockMovement`](file:///C:/Users/Lenovo/Downloads/AI-RULES-worktrees/eval-scratch/andino-capability-eval-ri7o9egq/work/app.py) Entity
Replaces direct destructive stock overwrites to support Sunday hand-counting and shrinkage tracking:
- `id` (INTEGER, Primary Key)
- `product_id` (INTEGER, Foreign Key to [`Product`](file:///C:/Users/Lenovo/Downloads/AI-RULES-worktrees/eval-scratch/andino-capability-eval-ri7o9egq/work/app.py))
- `change_type` (TEXT, Not Null): `sale`, `restock`, `sunday_audit`, `waste_damage`.
- `quantity_delta` (INTEGER, Not Null): Negative for sales/waste, positive for restocks, signed difference for audits.
- `previous_stock` (INTEGER, Not Null)
- `new_stock` (INTEGER, Not Null)
- `recorded_by_user` (TEXT, Not Null)
- `notes` (TEXT, Nullable): e.g., "Sunday count variance (-2 units missing)".
- `created_at` (TIMESTAMP, Default UTC Now)

#### C. [`UserRole`](file:///C:/Users/Lenovo/Downloads/AI-RULES-worktrees/eval-scratch/andino-capability-eval-ri7o9egq/work/app.py) Entity
- `id` (INTEGER, Primary Key)
- `username` (TEXT, Unique)
- `password_hash` (TEXT)
- `role` (TEXT, Not Null): `'owner'` or `'cashier'`.

### 3. Permissions Matrix

| Operation | Owner | Cashier | Architectural Boundary |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :--- |
| **Browse / Search Catalog** | Allowed | Allowed | Cashier needs search by barcode or name at the till. |
| **View `selling_price`** | Allowed | Allowed | Required to ring up sales. |
| **View `cost_price` & Margins** | Allowed | **Denied** | Commercial confidentiality; stripped from Cashier API payloads. |
| **Create / Edit / Deactivate Product** | Allowed | **Denied** | Only the owner sets purchasing prices and catalogs. |
| **Record Till Sale (`current_stock` - N)** | Allowed | Allowed | Core cashier checkout function; writes [`StockMovement`](file:///C:/Users/Lenovo/Downloads/AI-RULES-worktrees/eval-scratch/andino-capability-eval-ri7o9egq/work/app.py) `sale`. |
| **Submit Sunday Stock Count** | Allowed | Allowed (Log only) | Cashier enters actual shelf count; system logs difference as `sunday_audit`. |
| **Restock Received Goods** | Allowed | **Denied** | Owner accepts wholesale delivery and updates inventory. |
| **User & Access Management** | Allowed | **Denied** | Owner manages staff credentials. |

    is_active = db.Column(db.Boolean, default=True, nullable=False)

class StockMovement(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = "stock_movements"
    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    product_id = db.Column(db.Integer, db.ForeignKey("products.id"), nullable=False)

    notes = db.Column(db.String(255))
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, default=lambda: datetime.now(timezone.utc))

def require_role(*roles):
    def decorator(fn):
        @wraps(fn)
        def wrapper(*args, **kwargs):
            user_role = session.get("role")
            if not user_role or user_role not in roles:
                abort(403, description="Unauthorized role")
            return fn(*args, **kwargs)
        return wrapper
    return decorator
